30435698.remarks: Welcome to 1777 Pinewood Drive, an award-winning hilltop retreat on a private cul-de-sac offering unbelievable views, distinctive architecture & exceptional craftsmanship. Winner of a 2005 Georgie Award for Best New Custom Home, this 3,306 sq. ft. residence was built by Craig Macpherson of Macpherson Fine Homes. A striking Douglas fir tree rises through the main living area, connecting the kitchen, dining & living spaces. Features include soapstone countertops, alder cabinetry & custom forged-iron railings. With 4 bedrooms plus den, an oversized single garage with workshop & a separate 1 bed/1 bath revenue suite, there's space for family & guests. A filming location for The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 2, this unique Pemberton home offers privacy, character & a story all its own. (id:67604)

30439154.remarks: A bright, Cozy and Spacious  4 bedroom and  3.5 bath townhome in good sought after Panorama West Coast.
